北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天干，体感-4℃，很冷！注意防风保暖多补水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and dry, feels -4℃, very cold! Stay warm and hydrated.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，出行请注意交通安全，别忘了戴口罩。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, please drive safely and wear a mask.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温微凉。早晚温差大，记得加件外套哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool. Mind the temperature difference, wear a jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温舒适。记得多喝水，防晒要做好呀。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasant. Stay hydrated and don't forget sunscreen!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温宜人。保持好心情，适量活动哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and pleasant. Keep a good mood, enjoy some light activities!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，气温有点凉。出行记得戴口罩，注意呼吸健康。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is hazy and a bit chilly. Wear a mask for your respiratory health!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京风大有霾，体感7℃。注意防风保暖，外出戴好口罩。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is hazy and windy, feels 7℃. Stay warm, wear a mask outdoors.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天潮湿，体感偏凉。记得多添衣，保持舒适哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and humid, feels cool. Layer up and stay comfortable!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，请注意防护。外出记得戴口罩，保持室内通风。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is hazy, please take precautions. Wear a mask and ventilate indoors.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感3℃，偏冷干燥。出门记得多穿点，暖暖和和的。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels 3℃, cold/dry. Dress warmly when going out!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆小雨，天气湿冷。出门带伞，注意防潮保暖别着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has light rain, it's damp and cool. Bring an umbrella, stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨严寒大风，体感-22℃！请务必多穿，全副武装保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold and windy, feels -22℃! Bundle up tightly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳寒风凛冽，体感-14℃。外出务必穿厚保暖，谨防感冒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is very cold and windy, feels -14℃. Dress warmly to avoid colds!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，气温宜人。享受美好天气，心情也要美美的。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy the beautiful weather and your mood!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温温暖舒适。很适合户外走走，呼吸新鲜空气。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and comfortably warm. Perfect for a walk outdoors!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阳光正好，但体感4℃，偏凉。早晚温差大，注意加衣别着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but feels 4℃, cool. Mind the temperature changes, dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风大体感-6℃，很冷！注意防风保暖。多喝热水，暖暖身子。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is windy and feels -6℃, cold! Stay warm, drink hot water to warm up!
